title: Senior AI Engineer at Lemon.io
description_review: Senior remote AI Engineer opening at Lemon.io focusing on AI Agent and AI Automation architecture for US and European startups. Requires 3+ years in AI solutions, Python, vector databases (Pinecone/Weaviate), LangChain, and LLM orchestration. Offers flexible hours and async remote work.
pros: Directly matches applied AI agent architecture and LLM orchestration experience
Covers vector databases and modern AI engineering workflows
Offers flexible remote work with high autonomy
cons: Demands Python and LangChain rather than candidate's core Java/Spring Boot enterprise stack
Agency talent marketplace rather than direct enterprise engineering team

title: Senior .NET Full-stack Developer at Lemon.io
description_review: Senior remote full-stack role at Lemon.io with multiple openings across .NET & React, C# & .NET, and Angular & .NET. Requires 4+ years software development experience, 3+ years with .NET, along with React or Angular and TypeScript proficiency. Fully remote serving US and European startup clients.
pros: Highlights Angular & .NET track where candidate has 6 years of Angular/TypeScript experience
Matches senior full-stack responsibilities delivering end-to-end features
cons: Primary backend requirement is .NET/C# rather than core Java/Spring Boot
Lacks enterprise banking/fintech domain and AI modernization elements

title: Senior Data Scientist at Lemon.io

Core responsibilities include building RAG systems and LLM applications from scratch with robust architecture. Flexible remote schedule with async communication.
pros: Focuses on RAG and LLM application architecture where candidate has practical applied AI skills
Senior level autonomous remote work environment
cons: Position is dedicated Data Science rather than Software Engineering or backend development
Requires Databricks and data science modeling outside candidate's core backend profile

title: Senior Independent AI Engineer / Architect at A.Team
description_review: Senior AI Engineer / Architect role with invite-only builder network A.Team developing production AI systems for enterprises and global companies. pros: Outstanding fit for candidate's multi-agent platform and orchestration system development experience
Emphasizes enterprise-grade AI production deployments and architectural trade-offs
Senior architect scope working directly with leadership on high-impact projects
cons: Consulting/network model rather than a single in-house engineering team

title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer at Mitre Media
description_review: Tech Lead Full-Stack role at Mitre Media architecting LLM-powered financial web applications within a microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Powers fintech platforms like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com serving asset managers like BlackRock. Remote role requiring timezone overlap within ±3 hours of Eastern Time.
pros: Strong fintech domain alignment serving institutional asset managers and individual investors
Senior Tech Lead scope covering microservices architecture and LLM integration into production workflows
cons: Core backend stack is Ruby on Rails 8 where candidate has no professional experience
Strict requirement for expert Rails development rather than Java/Spring Boot
